name: WePlayCartographerEquipment
title: WePlay: Cartographer Equipment
author: afewvowels
description: Personal radar equipment. Charts the map around you while worn in armor or installed in the grid of a vehicle you're driving, so new planets and outposts reveal themselves as you explore. No hidden entities: it stores power and a light script charts around you. Range, scan rate and power draw are configurable, and higher quality units see farther. Does not require Space Age. Multiple units don't stack range: the best charged unit does each scan and extras act as backups. If you'd like stacking, let me know in the discussions tab!
